title: BR-005: mutating action without an effect_key is rejected before any connector call
risk: Actions without a deterministic key cannot be de-duplicated, so a retry storm creates duplicate messages and duplicate orders.
preconditions: Namespace gov-unit-br-<case_id>-<worker_id>; Business Rules Engine loaded with no cross-case state.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; agent fixture context loaded from fixtures/offline/governance.json.

steps.action: Evaluate the mutating action that carries no effect_key
steps.expected: Rule fails with ERR_MISSING_EFFECT_KEY; the action never reaches the connector.

steps.action: Evaluate the control action carrying a key
steps.expected: BR-005 passes and the action is dispatched exactly once.

steps.action: Attempt a retry of the keyless action
steps.expected: The retry is rejected the same way; no second dispatch and no synthesized key.

assertions: Adapter counter is 1 after all three attempts, proving only the control action dispatched.
No key is generated server-side to paper over the missing field.
The rejection is recorded with the action type that lacked the key.
forbidden: Auto-generating a random key at dispatch time.
Allowing read-only actions to fail the same check and blocking harmless reads.
Dispatching first and attaching the key afterwards.
evidence: Rule evaluation records for all three attempts.
Adapter counter log and audit rows for the dispatched control action.
